jūstus

jūstus, jūsta, jūstum

adjective

proper, complete, regular, of the right size

In this lexicon

  • proper

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. B.C. 1.23: iter jūstum, a regular day’s march (Lewis & Short); Liv. 9.43: exercitus, an army at full strength (Lewis & Short)
